section: Regional parties in India and in Andhra Pradesh - rise, role and impact

accepted.s:
Which of the following developments was highlighted in the context of the 2026 West Bengal election?
1. Trinamool Congress suffered defeat.
2. Defections involving AITC, AAP Rajya Sabha Members of Parliament and NCP-SP attracted attention.
3. Analysts emphasised that vote share, rather than seats alone, indicates the extent of regional support.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. The developments mentioned were the Trinamool Congress defeat in West Bengal, defections involving the specified parties, and the emphasis on vote share as an indicator of regional support.
accepted.tq: Use the all-inclusive option only after checking each statement against the distinct developments.

accepted.s: In assessing the strength of a regional party, analysts caution that which of the following is a more meaningful indicator than seats alone?
o: The number of defections from other parties
Number of Rajya Sabha Members only
Whether the party supports the Union Government
accepted.x: Vote share is considered an important indicator of the extent of regional support, whereas seats alone may not fully reflect that support.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the substantive electoral indicator from related but incomplete political measures.

accepted.s:
With reference to the electoral performance of the Biju Janata Dal, consider the following statements:
1. The BJD won 182 Lok Sabha seats between 1999 and 2024.
2. The period referred to extends from 1999 to 2024.
3. The figure relates to Assembly seats won in Odisha.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The BJD won 182 Lok Sabha seats between 1999 and 2024. Statement 3 is false because the figure refers to Lok Sabha seats, not Assembly seats.
accepted.tq: Check the precise chamber and time range before accepting a numerical statement.

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes the political position of the Telugu Desam Party in Andhra Pradesh?
o: It is outside the ruling coalition and is supported by the BJD.
It leads the ruling coalition with support from the Trinamool Congress.
It leads the ruling coalition with support from the Bharatiya Janata Party.
It leads the ruling coalition without support from any other party.
accepted.x: In Andhra Pradesh, the Telugu Desam Party leads the ruling coalition with support from the Bharatiya Janata Party.
accepted.tq: Test the party–coalition relationship by identifying both the leading party and its supporting ally.

accepted.s: The proposal of “One Nation, One Election” has been criticised in the context of regional parties because it is feared to
o: transfer recognition of regional parties to State legislatures
increase the number of regional parties automatically
accepted.x: The proposal is feared to weaken regional parties by creating a more nationally dominated electoral environment. The other alternatives go beyond the stated criticism.
accepted.tq: Apply the stated criticism to the likely institutional impact rather than choosing an absolute consequence.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding elections in India:
1. The first five general elections were held simultaneously.
2. The simultaneity of the first five general elections is relevant to the debate on “One Nation, One Election”.
3. Simultaneous elections were first introduced only after the 2026 West Bengal election.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The first five general elections were simultaneous, and this historical experience is relevant to the debate on “One Nation, One Election”. Statement 3 is false because the simultaneity occurred during the first five general elections, not after 2026.
accepted.tq: Use the chronological trap to reject a statement that places an established historical fact in a later period.
